about: Renew your DHA professional registration for another year. For healthcare professionals only.
note: Requirements read from the official DHA service page on the checked date. DHA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Only for healthcare professionals (doctors, dentists, nurses and similar), not for patients or the general public
Renew within three months of the expiry date
Registration must not be expired, you must not be revoked or blacklisted and you must have no unpaid fines
documents: Valid passport copy, if not already on file
Good Standing Certificate valid within six months
